title: How would I go about displaying an icon above the player?

posts.author: WexfordDictionary
posts.body:
Hi! I got my hands on RPG Maker XP about 2 weeks ago and have been messing around with it. I have a nice, promising project going, even slowly learning Ruby as I go.
But right now, I have an issue. I want to find out how I can display an icon above the player, as in they hold it over their head in celebration! How would I go about scripting this??
Link to video demonstration

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: You could just change the character sprite via event command. It should be a sprite that includes both your hero and the item he or she has found.

posts.author: WexfordDictionary
posts.body: The game is going to have hundreds of items, so I'd rather not resort to that.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: If you do the first part and leave the item or weapon or piece of armor as a secondary sprite, you could exchange the normal hero's sprite with the lucky one AND move a previously created event with the given graphic above the player. To keep the second event hidden, you'd need to use a game switch as its trigger condition. Then right after you save the change hero's graphic command, you'd move the event and turn on the game switch.

posts.author: WexfordDictionary
posts.body: Again, I would rather have this as a script.
